title: PKL-Bench: The Pro Kabaddi League Research Benchmark Dataset and Evaluation Suite
description: PKL-Bench is the first comprehensive, research-grade, multi-tier benchmark dataset and evaluation harness for professional Kabaddi. Spanning all 10 complete seasons (2014-2024) of the Pro Kabaddi League (PKL), PKL-Bench harmonizes 1,060 matches, 26,760 player boxscores, and 103,176 discrete raid events into a standardized 5-tier relational schema distributed in both Apache Parquet and Frictionless CSV formats.
